title: Post-sign-in assistant
description: After authentication, the product can automatically surface the assistant (`browser.oasis.postAuthOpenAssistant`).
content:
Post-sign-in assistant

After authentication, the product can automatically surface the assistant (browser.oasis.postAuthOpenAssistant).

What this is

After you sign in to Kahana inside Oasis, the product can automatically surface the assistant so you are not hunting for the panel.

How to use it

  • Complete OAuth or email sign-in from the assistant Auth view.
  • On success, the sidebar or overlay may open or focus automatically (depending on build defaults).
  • If you prefer a quieter flow, ignore the assistant until you need it; state is saved per account.

Notes and limits

This behavior is separate from Firefox Sync; Kahana sign-in does not log you into Mozilla’s sync servers.
